test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

A S D F_ A _ _ F G _ U D _ G A _ _ F G

options.text: G T D A F V D
F T E A F W D
F T D A F V D
G T E A G X E

solution: **Given:** A S D F_ A _ _ F G _ U D _ G A _ _ F G Checking all the given options: **1. G T D A F V D** A**S**DFG / A**T**DFG / A**U**DFG / A**V**DFG
